killedBy: the arm's mine directions, as capacities (issue #358's second axis) stamps mine capacities at spawn, alongside the shell caps and only with the arm on
why: Applies HALF the approved matrix: shell caps stamped, mine directions silently skipped, so `?dev=1&pp1Roles=1` claims the PP1 role arm while Brown/Teal/Green still carry the two mines the matrix removes. A half-applied arm is worse than none, because a playtest under it produces evidence attributed to a roster nobody approved. The two tables are consulted in one pass but independently -- their memberships differ, since grey takes the shell arm only -- and that independence is exactly what makes dropping one of them invisible to the other axis's tests. Replaced with a `void` read rather than a deletion so the import stays used and the mutation is the missing STAMP, not a compile error.
